patthana18.9:1.1: hetuṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: nahetuṃ saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: hetuṃ saraṇañca nahetuṃ saraṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.9:2.1: nahetuṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na nahetu na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. nahetuṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: nahetuṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na araṇo ca na nahetu na araṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sahetuka dukahetuduke nasahetukaduka nahetudukaṃ
